remarks: Completely renovated single family rental in the desirable Wolfpit area of Norwalk. Located on the Norwalk/Westport line just minutes from shops/restaurants, I95, Train Stations, SONO, Calf Pasture Beach & MORE! Everything is NEW! Main level includes 2 spacious bedrooms, living room, 1 full bathroom. Lower level you'll find a stunning EIK with all new stainless steel appliances, a third bedroom, laundry room, full bathroom & rec/play room! Plenty of storage/closet/cabinet space. Natural Gas for heat, hot water & stove keep the utilities LOW! City water paid by landlord(quarterly). Landlord responsible for ground maintenance. Parking in adjacent lot & street. Tenants MUST have good credit, proof of income & references.
